basic_details.job_title: TMC HBCHRCV Tele Radiology Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Visakhapatnam (TMC HBCHRCV) has announced 2 vacancy for the post of Tele Radiology Consultant under its 2026 recruitment notification (TMC/HBCHRCV/AD/64/2026). The engagement is temporary on a Bonded Fixed Term Appointment on Contractual Basis with the place of posting at HBCH&RC Visakhapatnam. Eligible candidates can apply online from 19 October 2026 up to the last date of 27 October 2026. Applicants must complete the online application process within the specified dates according to the terms mentioned in the official notification.

qualification.details: No. of Posts: 02 | Qualification: M.D. (Radio-diagnosis) (MCI recognized) / D.N.B. Radio-diagnosis) | Essential Experience: Minimum 3 years’ experience in oncology imaging. Valid NMC / MCI registration. | Age: 50 years | Consolidated salary: Rates as per Onco Tele-repor | Location: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Visakhapatnam

how_to_apply: Visit the official Tata Memorial Centre careers page or recruitment portal.

Locate the advertisement titled APPLICATIONS ARE INVITED FOR THE POST OF TELE RADIOLOGY CONSULTANT AT HBCH&RC, VISAKHAPATNAM THROUGH BONDED FIXED TERM APPOINTMENT ON CONTRACTUAL BASIS under advertisement number TMC/HBCHRCV/AD/64/2026.
Access the online application portal starting from 19 October 2026.
Complete the online application form with the required personal and professional details.
Submit the application before the closing date of 27 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: About TMC HBCHRCV Tele Radiology Consultant
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre is a grant-in-aid institution under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre located in Visakhapatnam operates under this umbrella. The centre offers specialized cancer care, research, and educational programs, engaging medical professionals through contractual and bonded fixed term appointments to support specialized patient services such as tele radiology.
